PC: Assess patient's airway, breathing and circulation and address issues as necessary with reevaluation as indicated
Conduct brief history and physical exam
Recognize the cholinergic toxidrome and start appropriate treatment with Mark-1 kit (or equivalent atropine and 2PAM)
If patient progresses to seizure activity, demonstrate proper use of benzodiazepines
SBP: Properly don PPE prior to treating the patient
Recognize the need for patient decontamination and removal from the area
Patient is transferred to the ER for further treatment
